title: 2026 UK ETS SAF claim-limit and carryover proposal QA controls

sources.title: Treatment of sustainable aviation fuel consultation accessible webpage

facts.source_fact: The Authority proposes limiting SAF emissions-reduction claims to total UK ETS aviation fuel consumption in the relevant scheme year.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve proposal status and annual basis.

facts.source_fact: A claim cannot exceed the operator's UK ETS aviation activity for that scheme year under the proposal.
The Authority proposes that SAF emissions-reduction claims cannot be carried into subsequent scheme years.
The stated rationale is that surrender obligations should reflect emissions in the relevant scheme year.
The proposed claim limit is not an allowance allocation rule.
facts.expected_handling: Separate SAF claim accounting from free allocation.

facts.source_fact: The proposal does not create a negative emissions balance when SAF exceeds in-scope fuel use.
The consultation distinguishes claim timing from physical fuel purchase and delivery evidence.
facts.expected_handling: Keep timing and evidence gates separate.

facts.source_fact: The consultation closed on 15 June 2026 and final policy requires an Authority Response.
The proposed limit affects surrender-obligation calculations, not gross aviation emissions for every purpose.
No parcel-level emission value can be inferred from the annual claim cap.
